about: [O5b] the hospital (brief O5b §1): a shot in the street by the wanted man's corner (heat 2, he draws), then the bot stands in the open and does nothing: he shoots me down - the black names him - and I come round in the hospital's ward bed: 'Came round.', the stitches paid out of my money, the heat gone, the gun kept; up, out of the ward, through the hall and out by the street door; my car where I left it.

steps.eval: (N.controller.pitch = 0, window.__fails = [], G.on('fail', (e) => window.__fails.push(e.why + ' -> ' + e.to)), G.save.money = 100, window.__car0 = [G.city.car.pos.x, G.city.car.pos.z], window.__msgs = [], setInterval(() => { const m = document.querySelector('#hud .msg'); const t = m && m.textContent; if (t && window.__msgs[window.__msgs.length - 1] !== t) window.__msgs.push(t); }, 100), 1)

(() => { const b = G.night.bounty.names()[0]; G.stage.part('stream').warmAround(b.x, b.z); const g = G.night.graph(); let px = b.x + 14, pz = b.z; for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) { const a = i * Math.PI / 8, q = new N.THREE.Vector3(b.x + Math.cos(a) * 14, 0, b.z + Math.sin(a) * 14); const q0 = q.clone(); G.stage.colliders.resolve(q, 0.4); if (q.distanceTo(q0) < 0.05 && g.lineOfSight(q.x, q.z, b.x, b.z) && !G.stage.part('city').C.inWater(q.x, q.z)) { px = q.x; pz = q.z; break; } } N.controller.setPose(px, pz, Math.atan2(-(b.x - px), -(b.z - pz)), -0.02); G.stage.part('bounds').navAround(px, pz, 24); return [b.name, Math.round(px), Math.round(pz)]; })()

steps.label: standing in the open: he puts me down

came round in the ward's bed
steps.expect: window.__msgs.some((m) => /Came round/.test(m)) && G.city.places.inside && G.city.places.inside.id === 'hospital' && G.city.places.seat && G.city.places.seat.name === 'wardbed'

steps.name: the stitches paid, the heat gone, the gun kept

steps.walk: (() => { const s = G.city.places.byId.get('hospital'), F = s.frame, K = s.live.K; return [[0, K.wakeBed.z], [0, -9.4], [0, -6.4], [0, -2.2], [0, -0.6], [0, 2.8]].map(([x, z]) => { const p = F.w(x, z); return [p.x, p.z]; }); })()

steps.expect: !G.city.places.inside && (() => { const s = G.city.places.byId.get('hospital'), p = s.frame.l(N.controller.pos.x, N.controller.pos.z); return p.z > 1.0; })()
